get.description: How the device connects to the platform broker (TELEMETRY_MQTT_URL: URL, host, port, TLS, MQTT 3.1.1) and publishes (its own topic, QoS 1), and how the broker authenticates it (TELEMETRY_MQTT_AUTH): without authentication any client may publish; with password authentication the device logs in as its own broker user (username = device id), whose password the platform operator provisions with the broker. No secret is issued or returned. 404 for devices of other organizations; 409 DEVICE_NOT_MQTT for http devices, which post with their API key.

get.description: The devices the vessel’s organization registered on it, by name: id, name, kind, status and lastSeenAt, never credentials. The vessel must belong to the caller’s organization (platform administrators: any); the devices are those counted by GET /telemetry/vessels.

post.description: All or nothing: every reading is validated (non-negative, ≤ configured maxima, time ≤ now + TELEMETRY_MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_MIN and at most TELEMETRY_MAX_AGE_DAYS old, periodStart before time) and every vessel must belong to the caller’s organization before anything is stored. A vessel has one reading per time: an exact repeat (same period, amounts and device) is an idempotent duplicate; a different reading at a stored (mmsi, time) — other values, or another device of the vessel — answers 409 READING_CONFLICT and nothing of the request is stored. Stored readings are published as fuel.reading.recorded.v1 after the commit (Nats-Msg-Id <mmsi>:<time>). Error fields are `<index>.<field>`.

get.description: Time-ordered cursor pages: ascending by default, `order=desc` newest first (the newest readings: `order=desc&limit=20`; `to` defaults to now, so pass a later `to` for readings up to TELEMETRY_MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_MIN ahead of the server clock). `[from, to)`; buckets whose start lies in the range. Hourly and daily sums come from the continuous aggregates: readings stored more than an hour after their time (store and forward, imports) are included after the next refresh (fuel_hourly every 15 min, fuel_daily hourly).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` oldest first (default) or `desc` newest first, e.g. the newest readings with `order=desc&limit=20`; the cursor continues in its own order (a cursor of the other order is a 400)

get.description: The series of GET …/readings (same `from`, `to` and `bucket`, defaults and range limits; ascending) as one streamed RFC 4180 file (`Content-Disposition: attachment`): the header line `time,periodStart,fuelMeTon,fuelAeTon,totalFuelTon,readings,source,deviceId`, CRLF line ends, the values of the JSON points (empty for null; periodStart, source and deviceId only for raw readings). Errors before the first byte are problem details; a failure during the transfer aborts the connection, so a cut file never looks complete.

info.description: Fuel consumption telemetry: readings ingest over REST and MQTT, device registry, queries and status; publishes fuel.reading.recorded.v1

catalogued.description: Whether the catalog shipped with @darmawanweb/ais-its-contracts describes the method

needsCitation.description: Values come from the thesis without a verified external source

mmsi.description: MMSI of the vessel the device is installed on (its organization owns the device)

kind.description: `mqtt`: publishes to MQTT topic `aisits/telemetry/<id>`; `http`: posts readings with its API key

apiKeyId.description: Id of the API key (scope `telemetry:ingest`) of an http device; required for http, refused for mqtt

mmsi.description: Vessel the device is installed on

vesselName.description: Name of the vessel (FLEET projection); null while the MMSI is not a live vessel of the fleet

apiKeyId.description: API key of an http device; its readings are attributed to the device

mqttTopic.description: MQTT topic the device publishes to (mqtt devices)

lastSeenAt.description: When the device last delivered readings (receipt time, minute resolution)

lastReadingAt.description: Measurement time of the newest reading stored as the device’s on its current vessel (minute resolution, written with lastSeenAt; never moves back; null again after a move to another vessel, until the first reading there)

connectionState.description: inactive: switched off (readings refused); never: no reading on its current vessel yet; online: newest reading at most activeWindowMin old (the vessel telemetry "active" rule, method fuel.method_selection: its vessel’s telemetry is active); idle: older, up to offlineAfterMin; offline: older than offlineAfterMin

activeWindowMin.description: Age of the newest reading up to which the device is online, minutes (TELEMETRY_ACTIVE_WINDOW_MIN)

offlineAfterMin.description: Age of the newest reading beyond which the device is offline, minutes (TELEMETRY_DEVICE_OFFLINE_AFTER_MIN)

total.description: Number of items across all pages

brokerUrl.description: The platform broker as devices reach it (TELEMETRY_MQTT_URL, port explicit): mqtts = TLS

tls.description: The broker requires TLS (an mqtts:// broker URL)

protocolVersion.description: MQTT version to connect with (protocol level 4): the NATS MQTT gateway implements MQTT 3.1.1, not MQTT 5

topic.description: The topic the device publishes its readings to (only its own)

qos.description: QoS to publish with: at least once (QoS 0 messages sent just before a disconnect can be lost; repeats are stored once)

authentication.description: none: the broker accepts any client (development); password: the device logs in as its own broker user, whose password the platform operator provisions (never issued or returned by this API)

username.description: The device’s broker user (its id) under password authentication; null without authentication

mmsi.description: Move the device to another vessel of the same organization

apiKeyId.description: API key of an http device; `null` unlinks it (required for http devices)

id.description: Device id (the `deviceId` of its raw readings)

status.description: Registry status: readings of inactive devices are rejected

lastSeenAt.description: When the device last delivered readings (receipt time, minute resolution)

mmsi.description: MMSI of the vessel (must belong to the organization of the caller)

time.description: End of the measured period, ISO-8601 UTC (millisecond precision; at most TELEMETRY_MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_MIN ahead and TELEMETRY_MAX_AGE_DAYS old)

periodStart.description: Start of the measured period (before `time`, at most TELEMETRY_MAX_PERIOD_H earlier)

fuelMeTon.description: Main-engine fuel burnt in the period, t (≥ 0, ≤ TELEMETRY_MAX_FUEL_ME_TON)

fuelAeTon.description: Auxiliary-engine fuel burnt in the period, t (≥ 0, ≤ TELEMETRY_MAX_FUEL_AE_TON)

duplicates.description: Exact repeats (same period, amounts and device) of stored readings or within the request (ignored, idempotent)

published.description: Accepted readings already published to the FUEL stream; the others follow through the relay within TELEMETRY_RELAY_AFTER_S

readings.description: Readings in the point (1 for raw readings)

periodStart.description: Start of the measured period (raw readings)

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on the last page

readings.description: Readings whose time lies in the range

receivedAt.description: When the service stored the reading

active.description: Newest reading at most activeWindowMin minutes old (method fuel.method_selection)
